scope: One continuing implementation and acceptance stage for every applicable character behavior in Raising, Hunt, Battle and character-facing status/results.

roster.note: Four extra species bindings reuse existing resources. Resource counts are not behavior counts. Eggs are not automatically eligible for adult or battle behavior.

authorities.behavior: Existing native Raising/Hunt/Battle owners and verified ROM contracts
authorities.stateAndSave: Existing standalone application, session, RNG and save repository
authorities.presentation: Existing DOM UI and one Pixi Application/ticker
authorities.evidence: Source -> condition/state -> numeric request -> native timeline -> cell/geometry -> feedback -> interruption/exit -> persistence

rules: A source sequence inventory cannot close a behavior row.
Each applicable row needs original conditions, entry, continuation, interruption, exit and side effects.
Normal-path claims require ordinary input through the existing owner; a seeded fixture is labeled controlled setup.
Never infer new emotions, numeric gameplay, timing or state transitions from a visual name.
An inapplicable species/behavior pair needs original eligibility evidence; absence of a frame is not proof of inapplicability.
No new phase or permission gate is required to continue the Owner-authorized work.
Full stage closure requires resolving every applicable row; no averaging, sampling or relabeling UNKNOWN as PASS.
